body.description: For non-client compilations with an app directory, webpack configuration installs NextTypesPlugin. During asset processing, the plugin scans page and route chunks, including concatenated modules, filters eligible App Router server-component files, and emits TypeScript guard files for layouts, pages, and route handlers under types/app. It collects production route types and layout parameters, conditionally emits types/server.d.ts when root parameters are found, and emits types/package.json declaring module format.

participants.role: Owns compilation hooks, module selection, route and layout metadata collection, and generated type asset emission.
